intent: Write the test for R2dbcAuditTrail (context telemetry-ingestion-processing) at the test file path; the unit under test lives at src/main/java/com/pulsestream/telemetry/eventlog/infrastructure/R2dbcAuditTrail.java. Assert only against the tabled surface. R2DBC adapter of AuditTrail for context Telemetry Event Log: inserts one row into append-only audit_trail (actor, action, outcome, occurred_at, correlation_id); never updates or deletes. On a database failure it increments counter telemetry.pipeline.dropped with tag stage=audit and completes empty (on_failure: swallowed and counted; on_success: row durable). TEST DUTIES: REAL-SUBSTRATE: run the actual V1/V2 migrations through Flyway on embedded H2, call record and assert the durable audit_trail row fields; also assert two records produce two rows. A mocked-client case may be added only for the failure path asserting telemetry.pipeline.dropped{stage=audit} increments and no error propagates.

methods.semantics: insert failure: counted in telemetry.pipeline.dropped{stage=audit}, completes empty
